comparison.plain_language: both clear; B slightly more concise and explicitly explains duplicate test coverage, without a material rubric difference
test_design_differences: A explicitly exercises both roles through report_rows and both formats; B exercises both tenant administrators through both formats and additionally tests a missing-tenant administrator.

B hard-codes expected columns and JSON text, providing a more independent compatibility oracle; A derives expected columns from REPORT_COLUMNS and JSON from report_rows plus json.dumps. The final code preserves the original convention in both.

B covers zero and negative net totals and multiple customer strings; A combines LF/CRLF/quotes/commas into one round-trip case and uses a larger integer with negative tax. Both cover the requested edge cases.
comparison.limits: One workflow per label. These observations do not establish a statistical effect or support inferring any hidden condition.
